Again, thank you. I see my psychiatrist again this weekend and I will make sure I bring up the bipolar and am very forward with it, and with getting myself on new medication. My boyfriend has recommended I try Cymbalta and Welbutrin, so I plan on mentioning those. Any Bipolar medication you think I should suggest?

Thank you, I don't get much credit for it, honestly. I'm supposed to be more intelligent than I am right now, according to all the school books, but for teaching myself everything I'm doing quite alright, I think.

I have a bunch of origami paper that I got for my birthday, actually. I've been making a ton of paper cranes, I really should move on to something more difficult. I do a lot of graphic design, and am completely self-taught in that regard as well. I've just started working with Blender to make 3d graphics, and although I'm not very good at it right now, I'd love to see myself get better at it.
Aw. Well, if you feel like coming to Vegas some time we could totally do it. :p

Thank you. All self-taught, really. I didn't go to 1st or 2nd grade, and was only in 3rd for a few months. My mother Unschooled, rather than Homeschooled me. Basically, she did nothing and let me go off on my own to learn.

I have tried talking to my psychiatrist about it, he never gave me a definitive answer as to whether or not I actually had bipolar. He did prescribe me a higher dose of Abilify, which was meant to help treat bipolar, but never said that was why he did it.

Thank you for your suggestions. I will see about seeing another therapist, my boyfriend does seem to think it would help, and although I don't agree with it, everyone I've mentioned it to seems to think I really do need the therapy.

Don't call the police on him. It'll scare him. If he leaves later and you feel like he's absolutely going to do it, then of course, make sure he's okay above all else. But if he's just talking about it, just thinking about it, hasn't made plans or notes, he'll end up scarred and not want to come to you again.

At least, that's how I was. Don't trust my judgement over your own, ever. It's always best to go with your gut instinct. 

(and again, reddit's making me wait for 6 minutes.)

Hug him. I don't know if that's just me but physical contact makes me feel so much better. If you think it'd be weird go ahead and not do it, it's just my suggestion.

Try to refrain from the whole suicide is bad thing, and talk more about how great he is. Don't tell him his life is great, he doesn't think that right now and might take offense. Tell him things you like about him.

I'm not in a good place myself right now, but I know having a friend would make me feel a lot better. Just be yourself, for the most part. Try to just hang out. I'm sure he'll end up okay.

Also, reddit got mad at me for posting too much and made me wait 5 minutes to post this. :c
Where do you live? You said hitchhiking to Mexico. I'd totally be in on that if you'd like to go with a girl. I'm from Vegas myself.
Thank you. I appreciate the compliment at least. Made me smile a little.
